lessonTitle: Claude for long documents and artifacts

slides.title: Built for Careful, Long-Document Reasoning
bullets: Claude is known for careful reasoning, safety orientation, and precision
Particularly strong at analyzing long, complex documents
These traits map directly onto recurring MSL tasks
Fits alongside, not instead of, the other tools in this module

slides.title: Processing Entire Long Documents at Once
bullets: Handles full trial protocols, long study reports, and lengthy clinical guidelines
Can process a large volume of congress notes in one pass
Extracts key points and flags inconsistencies or gaps
Cites the specific part of the document behind each answer
Ranked among the strongest tools for this task in recent comparisons

slides.title: Drafting Structured, Well-Formatted Documents
bullets: Congress debrief reports, executive summaries, education material drafts
Tends to keep a clear structure and consistent professional tone
MSL still reviews, verifies, and adapts to compliance requirements

slides.title: Cross-Checking Two Documents at Once
bullets: Compare an approved label against a recent scientific article
Systematically surfaces similarities, differences, and subtle nuances
Saves preparation time ahead of an important meeting

slides.title: General Knowledge Still Needs Verification
bullets: Strong on documents provided directly, not on very recent general knowledge
Never assume its background knowledge is automatically up to date
Verify any clinical claim against the primary source before using it with an HCP
Same confidentiality rules apply: no company, unpublished, or patient data in prompts

takeaway.title: Claude's edge is disciplined analysis of long documents, with verification still owned by the MSL
bullets: Best suited to full document analysis, structured drafting, and cross-checking sources
General knowledge on recent or specific data is not guaranteed current
Confidentiality rules apply exactly as with any other AI tool
